mutations.original: return f"rules: {self.path} @ {self.sha[:7]} ({n} rule{'s' if n != 1 else ''})"
mutations.mutated: return f"rules: {self.path} @ {self.sha[:8]} ({n} rule{'s' if n != 1 else ''})"
mutations.note: Hash prefix length 7 -> 8 in the describe() line.
Plural condition flipped: n > 1 instead of n != 1, so zero rules renders as singular.
Candidate order reversed: the default now wins over the per-path file.
Source labels swapped, so a per-path hit reports source 'default'.
Dropped CRLF normalisation, so CRLF and LF copies of the same rules hash differently.
Dropped BOM stripping: a utf-8-sig file leaks \ufeff into the first rule.
all -> any: a paragraph with one leading-# line is dropped entirely instead of only pure headings.
Counter advanced after use, so ids start at R0 and are off by one.
